semantics.candidate_rule: Policy edit produces a candidate identity.
semantics.base_rule: Candidate references exact accepted base revision.
semantics.diff_rule: Semantic diff identifies changed subjects, rights, resources, conditions and precedence.
semantics.impact_rule: Potential authority expansion/reduction is explicit evidence.
semantics.model_rule: AI-generated policy edits remain inert candidates.
semantics.authority_rule: Creating/editing candidate does not grant policy-apply authority.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
